stories.headline: Google releases DiffusionGemma, an open text-diffusion model up to 4x faster than standard LLMs

key_facts.fact: Google released DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model under an Apache 2.0 license: a 26B Mixture-of-Experts that generates blocks of text in parallel via diffusion instead of token-by-token, delivering up to 4x faster generation on GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Introducing DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model that explores text diffusion... Released under an Apache 2.0 license, this 26B Mixture of Experts (MoE) model... delivering up to 4x faster text generation on GPUs.

key_facts.fact: The model reaches 1000+ tokens/sec on a single NVIDIA H100 and 700+ tokens/sec on an RTX 5090, activates only 3.8B parameters during inference, and fits within 18GB VRAM when quantized.
key_facts.excerpt: generates up to 4x faster token output on dedicated GPUs. (1000+ tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100, 700+ tokens per second on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090)... activates only 3.8B parameters during inference, DiffusionGemma fits comfortably within 18GB VRAM.

key_facts.fact: Weights are available on Hugging Face; Google notes output quality is lower than standard Gemma 4 and positions the model for local, low-concurrency workflows like in-line editing, code infilling and rapid iteration.
key_facts.excerpt: Access the experimental model weights (released under a permissive Apache 2.0 license) right now on Hugging Face... DiffusionGemma's overall output quality is lower than standard Gemma 4.

stories.headline: xAI's Grok Build CLI caught uploading entire user repos; Musk pledges to delete all prior data

key_facts.fact: A security researcher (cereblab) demonstrated that xAI's Grok Build CLI v0.2.93 packaged users' entire tracked repositories, including full git history and committed secrets/.env files, and uploaded them as git bundles to a Google Cloud Storage bucket, roughly 27,800x more data than the coding task required.
key_facts.excerpt: xAI's Grok Build coding CLI was packaging developers' entire tracked repositories, including full Git history, committed secrets, and API keys, and sending them to a Google Cloud Storage bucket. The upload volume was roughly 27,800 times greater than the data the coding task actually required.

key_facts.fact: The upload occurred even when the agent was explicitly told not to open files, and the privacy opt-out toggle did not stop it; only gitignoring files or a server-side flag (disable_codebase_upload) prevented the transfer, contradicting xAI's 'local-first' marketing.
key_facts.excerpt: With the prompt literally 'reply OK, do not open any files,' Grok still uploads a git bundle of the whole repo... A permission deny stops the agent READING a file into the chat; it does NOT stop the whole-repo git-bundle upload.

key_facts.fact: On July 14 Elon Musk said on X that all user data uploaded before the change would be 'completely and utterly deleted,' and xAI deployed a server-side fix that stopped whole-repo uploads.
key_facts.excerpt: 'As a precautionary measure, all user data that was uploaded to SpaceXAI before now will be completely and utterly deleted,' he said... Cereblab confirmed that after the CLI's devs set disable_codebase_upload to 'true,' Grok Build stopped transmitting entire repos to its servers.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's Sam Altman called the incident 'Concerning' and said it was 'a reason to favor open-source harnesses.'
key_facts.excerpt: also, a reason to favor open-source harnesses.

stories.headline: FDA approves Celcuity's Revtorpyk for advanced breast cancer, a win over Novartis and Roche

key_facts.fact: On July 14 the FDA approved Celcuity's gedatolisib (Revtorpyk) in combination with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, for HR-positive, HER2-negative, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer after at least one line of endocrine therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: On July 14, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved gedatolisib (Revtorpyk) in combination with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, for the treatment of adults with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer without a PIK3CA mutation detected.

key_facts.fact: In the Phase 3 VIKTORIA-1 trial, the gedatolisib-plus-fulvestrant doublet cut the risk of disease progression or death by 67% versus fulvestrant alone, while the triplet adding palbociclib cut it by 76%.
key_facts.excerpt: Revtorpyk, also known as gedatolisib, reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 67% in combination with fulvestrant, compared to fulvestrant alone... Patients in that group achieved a 76% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death.

key_facts.fact: Celcuity, a small public biotech, positioned the drug to improve on similar treatments from Novartis and Roche; CEO Brian Sullivan wants it to become a 'new standard of care' in second-line HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.
key_facts.excerpt: A small public biotech won approval for a breast cancer drug that was designed to improve on similar treatments from Novartis and Roche... Sullivan said... he wants to make Revtorpyk a 'new standard of care' for second-line HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer.

stories.headline: Daniel Ek's Neko Health raises $700M for preventive full-body scans ahead of US launch

key_facts.fact: Neko Health, the Stockholm health-tech startup co-founded by Spotify's Daniel Ek, announced a $700 million Series C on July 15, led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and co-led by O.G. Venture Partners.
key_facts.excerpt: Neko Health today announced the completion of its $700 million Series C funding round. The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and co-led by O.G. Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors Atomico, General Catalyst, and Lakestar.

key_facts.fact: The round follows a $260 million Series B in January 2025 and drew backers including Atomico, General Catalyst, Lakestar, Liberty City Ventures and BDT & MSD.
key_facts.excerpt: alongside new backers including Liberty City Ventures, Positive Sum, and BDT & MSD. The fundraise follows a $260 million Series B in January 2025.

key_facts.fact: Neko operates eight clinics in Sweden and Britain offering a 60-minute non-invasive full-body scan plus a blood test (priced at £299 in the UK) and plans to open its first US clinics, including in New York, this year.
key_facts.excerpt: The company, which operates eight clinics in Sweden and Britain and advertises its service as 'a health check for your future self,' offers full-body diagnostic scans - plus a blood test... A Neko Health scan in Britain is priced at 299 pounds ($400).
